## Headline Audit Summary

Every numbered theorem, proposition, lemma, corollary, definition, example, and remark in **Chapters 1–3** (where the dissertation ends; there is no Chapter 4+, and **Appendix C** contains no mathematical theorems or proofs) has a `sorry`-free Lean 4 verification (`lake build` in Lean `v4.35.0`). Appendices A (connected finite reduction), B, and D (16-relator check), plus both the even-$n$ and odd-$n$ cases of Theorem 1.6, are also verified in Lean 4 and Python (`pytest`).

## Complete 107-Statement Index {#complete-statement-index}

The table below is generated directly from [`original/mixed_sign_coxeter_statements_lean.csv`](https://github.com/jkylearmstrong/mixed.sign.coxeter.systems/blob/main/original/mixed_sign_coxeter_statements_lean.csv) ([download CSV](assets/mixed_sign_coxeter_statements_lean.csv)), linking every numbered item from Chapters 1–3 of the 2012 dissertation to its exact Lean 4 declaration in `lean/MixedSignCoxeter/` (and its upstream `lean/MathlibDraft/` counterpart where applicable).

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import csv
import html
from pathlib import Path

csv_path = next(
    p for p in (
        Path("../original/mixed_sign_coxeter_statements_lean.csv"),
        Path("original/mixed_sign_coxeter_statements_lean.csv"),
    )
    if p.exists()
)

with csv_path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))

statuses = {}
types = sorted({r["type"] for r in rows})
for r in rows:
    statuses[r["lean_status"]] = statuses.get(r["lean_status"], 0) + 1

badge_cls = {
    "Verified": "bg-success",
    "Formalized (definition)": "bg-primary",
    "Formalized (remark)": "bg-info text-dark",
    "Formalized (example)": "bg-info text-dark",
    "Addressed (counterexample)": "bg-warning text-dark",
    "Prose / notation": "bg-secondary",
}

summary_pills = " ".join(
    f'<span class="badge {badge_cls.get(k, "bg-secondary")} me-1 mb-1">{html.escape(k)}: {v}</span>'
    for k, v in sorted(statuses.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])
)

fence = "`" * 3
print(f"""{fence}{{=html}}
<div class="mb-3">
  {summary_pills}
</div>
<div class="row g-2 mb-3">
  <div class="col-md-4">
    <input id="stmt-search" type="search" class="form-control form-control-sm" placeholder="Filter by number, statement, Lean symbol, or note...">
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-2">
    <select id="stmt-chapter" class="form-select form-select-sm">
      <option value="">All chapters</option>
      <option value="1">Chapter 1 (1.1–1.7)</option>
      <option value="2">Chapter 2 (2.1–2.65)</option>
      <option value="3">Chapter 3 (3.1–3.35)</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-3">
    <select id="stmt-type" class="form-select form-select-sm">
      <option value="">All types</option>
      {''.join(f'<option value="{html.escape(t)}">{html.escape(t)}</option>' for t in types)}
    </select>
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-3">
    <select id="stmt-status" class="form-select form-select-sm">
      <option value="">All Lean statuses</option>
      {''.join(f'<option value="{html.escape(s)}">{html.escape(s)}</option>' for s in sorted(statuses.keys()))}
    </select>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="small text-muted mb-2" id="stmt-count">Showing {len(rows)} of {len(rows)} statements</div>
<div class="table-responsive">
<table class="table table-sm table-hover align-middle" id="stmt-table">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th style="white-space:nowrap;">#</th>
      <th>Type</th>
      <th style="min-width:260px;">Dissertation Statement</th>
      <th style="white-space:nowrap;">Lean Status</th>
      <th style="min-width:200px;">Lean 4 Counterpart</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
""")

for r in rows:
    num = r["number"]
    ch = num.split(".")[0]
    typ = r["type"]
    page = r["page"]
    sec = r["section"]
    stmt = r["statement"]
    status = r["lean_status"]
    lfile = r["lean_file"]
    lsym = r["lean_symbol"]
    lurl = r["lean_url"]
    mfile = r["mathlib_draft_file"]
    msym = r["mathlib_draft_symbol"]
    murl = r["mathlib_draft_url"]
    notes = r["lean_notes"]

    # Render Lean links
    lean_parts = []
    if lfile and lsym:
        fname = Path(lfile).name
        syms = [s.strip() for s in lsym.split(";") if s.strip()]
        sym_html = ", ".join(f"<code>{html.escape(s)}</code>" for s in syms)
        if lurl:
            lean_parts.append(f'<a href="{html.escape(lurl)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{html.escape(fname)}</a>: {sym_html}')
        else:
            lean_parts.append(f'{html.escape(fname)}: {sym_html}')
    if mfile and msym:
        mfname = Path(mfile).name
        msyms = [s.strip() for s in msym.split(";") if s.strip()]
        msym_html = ", ".join(f"<code>{html.escape(s)}</code>" for s in msyms)
        if murl:
            lean_parts.append(f'<div class="small text-muted mt-1">MathlibDraft <a href="{html.escape(murl)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{html.escape(mfname)}</a>: {msym_html}</div>')
    if notes:
        lean_parts.append(f'<div class="small text-muted mt-1">{html.escape(notes)}</div>')
    lean_cell = "".join(lean_parts) if lean_parts else '<span class="text-muted">—</span>'

    bcls = badge_cls.get(status, "bg-secondary")
    stmt_html = html.escape(stmt)
    meta_html = f'<div class="small text-muted mt-1">p. {html.escape(page)} · §{html.escape(sec)}</div>'

    print(
        f'<tr data-chapter="{html.escape(ch)}" data-type="{html.escape(typ)}" data-status="{html.escape(status)}">'
        f'<td style="white-space:nowrap;"><strong>{html.escape(num)}</strong></td>'
        f'<td style="white-space:nowrap;">{html.escape(typ)}</td>'
        f'<td>{stmt_html}{meta_html}</td>'
        f'<td style="white-space:nowrap;"><span class="badge {bcls}">{html.escape(status)}</span></td>'
        f'<td>{lean_cell}</td>'
        f'</tr>'
    )

print("""
  </tbody>
</table>
</div>
<script>
(function() {
  const qEl = document.getElementById('stmt-search');
  const chEl = document.getElementById('stmt-chapter');
  const tEl = document.getElementById('stmt-type');
  const sEl = document.getElementById('stmt-status');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('stmt-count');
  const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#stmt-table tbody tr'));
  function apply() {
    const q = (qEl.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const ch = chEl.value;
    const t = tEl.value;
    const s = sEl.value;
    let shown = 0;
    for (const tr of rows) {
      const okCh = !ch || tr.dataset.chapter === ch;
      const okT = !t || tr.dataset.type === t;
      const okS = !s || tr.dataset.status === s;
      const okQ = !q || tr.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const vis = okCh && okT && okS && okQ;
      tr.style.display = vis ? '' : 'none';
      if (vis) shown++;
    }
    countEl.textContent = `Showing ${shown} of ${rows.length} statements`;
  }
  qEl.addEventListener('input', apply);
  chEl.addEventListener('change', apply);
  tEl.addEventListener('change', apply);
  sEl.addEventListener('change', apply);
})();
</script>
""" + fence)
```
